title: Wizz Air Parks More Airbus XLR Aircraft After Long-Haul Retreat
summary: Wizz Air Holdings Plc has grounded more of its new extra-long range Airbus SE jets and has stripped the engines off some of the models as the budget carrier looks for ways to deploy the niche narrowbody plane after withdrawing from its long-haul strategy.

title: US Targets Iran’s Airlines as New Sanctions Push Continues
summary: The US took action against dozens of firms supporting Iran’s aviation sector on Tuesday, as part of a new sanctions effort from the Trump administration that hasn’t appeared to have much impact on Tehran’s main trading partners.

title: Private Credit’s Tokenization Revolution
summary: Apex Group CEO Peter Hughes joins Bloomberg Open Interest to explain why family offices need better access to quality private-market deals. He also makes the case that regulated tokenization could transform private credit, bringing 24/7 access, secondary-market liquidity and a potential end to traditional seven-to-10-year lockups. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Odd Lots: How Is Farm Equipment Used for Money Laundering?

title: China Ships Out First Sulfuric Acid Cargo Since Halt on Exports
summary: China has allowed its first outbound shipment of sulfuric acid since May, offering some relief to copper producers squeezed by a global shortage after the Iran war choked off Middle East supplies.

title: Buyout Debt Worth $138 Billion Set to Land in Credit Markets
summary: Credit investors look set to be spoiled for choice as bankers gear up to offload in excess of $138 billion of buyout debt in coming months.

title: Novartis and Boston Scientific Slide, Intel Price Hikes | Stock Movers
summary:
On this episode of Stock Movers:

- Novartis (NOVN) shares are lower as it suffered its third clinical-trial setback in a week after a treatment for a rare muscle-wasting disease failed a late-stage study.

- Boston Scientific (BSX) shares are moving on news it said that fallout from a cybersecurity incident has impacted its ability to ship its products to customers and will cause the medical devices company to miss its sales growth and earnings estimates for the year. 

- Intel (INTC) is rising on a report that the company could raise computer chip prices next month. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Gold Wavers as Traders Weigh Mideast Tensions and Dollar Moves
summary: Gold wavered, as traders weighed the competing effects of rising Middle East tensions and the US dollar’s decline against the yen.

title: Volatility Limits Post-Labor Day US Bond Rush to Six-Year Low
summary: The US investment-grade debt market is having its quietest post-Labor Day rush in six years, as fresh market volatility is keeping some borrowers on the sidelines.

title: Xerox Shareholder Pushes for Activist Changes at Company
summary: A significant shareholder in Xerox Holdings Corp. is pushing the company to take action to unlock shareholder value and is asking for a strategic review of its financial services business.

title: Banks Offer €2.8 Billion Debt Sale for Nestle Water Buyout
summary: Lenders including Bank of America Corp. and Deutsche Bank AG have launched a €2.8 billion ($3.3 billion) debt sale to help finance Platinum Equity’s purchase of a stake in Nestle SA’s water business.

title: OPEC Output Slumps as Conflict Curbs Saudi Flows, Survey Shows
summary: OPEC’s crude oil production tumbled in August, snapping a two-month recovery, as output from group leader Saudi Arabia was curbed by threats to both of its export routes, according to a Bloomberg survey.

title: Markets Bracing for PPI, CPI Reports This Week
summary: Even with a shortened trading week, two inflation reports could really move markets and impact the next Federal Reserve decision. First is the PPI report on Thursday, followed by the August CPI report that comes out Friday. Bloomberg's Michael McKee has a preview. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: SpaceX Shares to Get a Boost If Nasdaq 100 Increases Weighting
summary: SpaceX’s stock has been stuck in a tight trading range recently, but a wave of new buying may soon arrive when the Nasdaq 100 Index goes through its quarterly rebalancing later this month.

title: Nuclear Firm HGP Plans SPAC Deal at $1.2 Billion Value
summary: HGP Intelligent Energy plans to go public via a blank-check vehicle in a deal valuing the nuclear services firm at about $1.2 billion, according to a statement from the company on Tuesday.

title: Senegal to Negotiate a Debt Reprofiling in Talks With Creditors
summary: Senegal will seek to negotiate a debt reprofiling instead of a restructuring in talks with creditors as the West African nation moves to make its loans sustainable to qualify for an International Monetary Fund program.

title: CME Strikes Deal to Enter European Dairy Futures Market
summary: CME Group, the world’s biggest derivatives exchange, is expanding into the European dairy market as growing consumer demand for protein-rich foods fuels investor interest in the sector.

title: Xi Urges UK to Protect Chinese Investors in Call With Burnham
summary: China’s President Xi Jinping urged Britain to protect the legitimate rights and interests of Chinese investors in his first phone call with UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham, saying the two countries’ common interests outweigh their differences.
